scope: Six synthetic m3 ell3 prime-chain development fixtures; not n83 production

encoding.field: Small integer prime, either101 or103; all coefficients canonical integers modulo p
encoding.variables: Nine selectors z0..z8, three per block, followed by one unrestricted U; weights1,2,4 repeat per block; z_i^2=w_i*z_i
encoding.polynomial: List of [selector_mask,U_exponent,coefficient]; mask bitj means z_j; zero coefficients omitted
encoding.columns: List of [selector_mask,U_exponent], ordered increasingly by total degree then mask then U exponent; only degree<=d included
encoding.basis: List of objects with pivot column index and entries [column_index,coefficient]; normalized pivot coefficient1; zero entries omitted
encoding.degree: Selector-mask popcount plus U exponent; no U field equation
encoding.rank: Rank of the image of V_d in the selector quotient, not dimension of V_d in the unreduced polynomial ring

files.pP-tT.json: Full inputs, witness and both V4/V5 quotient bases for one fixed field/target fixture
files.summary.json: Six case summaries, exact witness degrees, memberships, quotient ranks and completed closure check counts; v2 additionally records rejection of the mutated witness g+1
files.test.log: All three native tests, build identity and diagnostic timing; no performance comparison
files.exit-code.txt: Controller exit status; zero for this completed development invocation
files.source/: Exact new Rust binary source, Cargo package/lock and pre-control design
files.test-instrument: Exact native executable for replay; no production entry point
files.manifest.json: Payload lengths and SHA256 hashes, excluding itself
files.build.json: Published source/binary identity and fixed development bounds

algorithm: Start normalized input rows; graded elimination; enqueue every variable multiple of each newly independent row of degree<d; stop only on empty queue. Check all final low-degree basis products again.
guards: At most9selectors, degree5,4096columns and50000processed rows;120second controller timeout and2GiB address-space cap. A hit is inconclusive.
replay: Run restored test-instrument --test-threads=1 with fresh N83_FILTERED_SMALL_OUT; compare six case JSON files and summary byte-for-byte
versions: development.tar.gz preserves the initial three-test invocation; development-v2.tar.gz adds the explicit g+1 negative control in all six fixtures. Both versions and replay logs remain retained; use v2 for the current implementation.
boundary: Zero scalar pairing is inconclusive; both exceptional fixtures still have witness outside V4 and inside V5. No universal/n83 LFD, exact global LFD, regularity, rational-point decomposition or elite-base claim. Independent mathematical review remains separate.
